document: final run and fold-10 analysis protocol for H3 (write-once)
written_before: any signal_plus_all model is trained and before any H3-type delta (signal_plus_all vs signal_plus_physio) is computed on any fold

sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.comparison: signal_plus_physio [age, sex] vs signal_plus_all [age, sex, device, site, nurse]
sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.metadata_fusion: metadata vector, encoded exactly as in v0.2.1 (encoder fit on training folds only), concatenated to the network's global-pooled embedding before the final linear classification head
sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.architecture_rule: disagreement is reported, never resolved by selection
sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.development: weeks 4-5: train folds 1-8, validate fold 9; all hyperparameters AND number of epochs fixed there
sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.final_run: train folds 1-9 with those fixed settings, no early stopping, no tuning; fold 10 evaluated exactly once
sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.primary_estimate: per-record probabilities averaged over the 3 seeds, then macro-AUROC; per-seed results secondary
sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.test: paired patient-level bootstrap on fold 10, N_BOOT=2000, BOOT_SEED=7, delta = macro_auroc(signal_plus_all) - macro_auroc(signal_plus_physio)

decision.a: 95% CI excludes 0 -> 'acquisition metadata changes performance' (report sign; either direction counts)

sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.SESOI_H3_note: comparable to the spread between published architectures on PTB-XL superclasses; an effect this size could reorder them. Fixed BEFORE any signal model is trained.
sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.exploratory: any analysis not specified here (ablations, per-class results, other block comparisons) is EXPLORATORY

stage_plan.v0.7: EXPLORATORY development matrix on fold 9: 2 architectures (resnet1d_wang, inception1d) x 3 arms (signal_only, signal_plus_physio, signal_plus_all) x 3 seeds (42, 123, 2024) at the locked lr 0.01; training on folds 1-8, fold-9 evaluation once at the end of epoch 50; recipe, folds 1-8 encoder (widths 256/259/338), age scaler and lead normalization exactly as dev_protocol.json, v0.5_training_details.json and the v0.5 code. Reused, NOT retrained (sha256-verified against v0.5_manifest.json, file sha256 59968bfb50d8c919de0e8004ef878a44a115560de438b7e74582877495e95f87; per-file hashes in v0.7_reused_v0.5_files): v0.5 resnet1d_wang signal_plus_physio seed 42 lr 0.01, v0.5 inception1d signal_plus_physio seed 42 lr 0.01, v0.5 resnet1d_wang signal_only seed 42 lr 0.01 -> 15 new runs. Status: EXPLORATORY; no setting may be chosen or changed from it. Known bias: lr was selected on fold 9 with signal_plus_physio, so on fold 9 the physio - signal_only delta is biased UPWARD and the all - physio delta DOWNWARD.
stage_plan.v0.8: final training on folds 1-9: 2 architectures x 3 arms x 3 seeds = 18 runs, lr 0.01, 50 epochs, everything else exactly as v0.5_training_details.json with the v0.8_overrides below; encoder, age scaler and lead normalization = the locked folds 1-9 values in locked_quantities (asserted equal at v0.8 STEP 0). signal_only is trained as an EXPLORATORY arm (used only in exploratory_fold10_comparisons). NO evaluation of any kind. v0.8 opens no fold-10 signal file and builds no fold-10 tensor (asserted). Saves per run the final state_dict, the training-loss CSV, and the sha256 of both in the v0.8 manifest.
stage_plan.v0.9: the single opening of fold 10 (effort = Max). First and only stage that reads fold-10 signals or labels; asserted by code. STEP 0 verifies this document, regenerates BOOT_IDX / PERM_IDX / the fold-10 id list with reference_implementation and asserts the locked hashes. Evaluation runs FROM THE SAVED, HASH-VERIFIED v0.8 state_dicts (CUDA kernels are not bitwise deterministic, so no model is re-trained or re-created by training). Evaluation = 7 windows, mean of sigmoid probabilities per record, exactly as v0.5, with the locked folds 1-9 lead normalization, age scaler and encoder applied to fold 10. The fold-10 probabilities of all 18 models are written to files and their sha256 recorded BEFORE any metric is computed. Fold-10 labels are derived with the v0.2.1 label code (verbatim).

v0.8_overrides.train_data: folds 1-9 (19601 records), RandomCropDataset as v0.5; per-lead normalization = locked folds 1-9 values
v0.8_overrides.metadata_encoding: categorical encoder and age_imputed scaler = locked folds 1-9 values
v0.8_overrides.per_run_outputs_v0.8: final state_dict and train_loss csv, sha256 of both in the v0.8 manifest
applies_unchanged: explicit rule (from 'validation'): no checkpoint selection; the model after the last optimizer step is final
v0.8_overrides.v0.9_evaluation: the 'evaluation' and 'metric' fields apply to fold-10 records in v0.9, with 'folds 1-8 statistics' replaced by the locked folds 1-9 lead normalization and age scaler

crash_and_rerun_rules.v0.7: a run may be re-run from scratch with the same seed only if it crashed or produced a non-finite training loss BEFORE its fold-9 evaluation; a run whose fold-9 evaluation was computed is never re-run; every attempt (including failed ones) is logged in the v0.7 manifest
crash_and_rerun_rules.v0.8: because v0.8 performs no evaluation, a run that crashes or yields a non-finite loss may be re-run from scratch with the same seed BEFORE v0.9; every attempt is logged in the v0.8 manifest. If the re-run fails again: stop and report; no setting may be changed except through a written, externally timestamped amendment made before v0.9. Once v0.9 has started, no re-run is allowed.

categorical_encoder.procedure: to_level_string (v0.2.1, zero-padded numeric levels) then encode_categorical with train_mask = all folds 1-9 rows; categories = sorted(training levels | {'__MISSING__'}) + ['__UNKNOWN__']; any level not among the training categories -> '__UNKNOWN__'
categorical_encoder.fold10_level_mapping: for each of device/site/nurse: to_level_string applied to the concatenation [folds 1-9 column, fold-10 column]; the folds 1-9 part must equal the folds 1-9-only level strings (asserted in v0.6); the fold-10 part is remapped with the categories above (same rule as encode_categorical)

physio_columns.age_sentinel: age == 300 -> age_censored = 1, age_imputed = 90; else age_censored = 0, age_imputed = age

lead_normalization.fit_on: v0.4 signal cache, all 19601 folds 1-9 records, sha256 17558f9d09b39b990d7f3a5ca2ea10e1527980288a49a6828c89b7c3df61745a
lead_normalization.procedure: two-pass float64: pass 1 sums per lead over chunks of 1000 records in cache row order, mean = sum / (n_records * 1000); pass 2 sums squared deviations the same way; std = sqrt(ss / (n_records * 1000)) (population std); applied as (x - mean) / std in float32
lead_normalization.comparison_rule_for_v0.8_v0.9: recomputed values must equal these with atol 1e-12 (as v0.5 did)

encoder_width_note: The 256/259/338 widths in dev_protocol.json 'metadata_fusion' describe the folds 1-8 fit used in development (device/site/nurse one-hot widths 13/52/14, signal_plus_all meta_dim 82). The sealed principle 'encoder fit on training folds only' is applied in the final run by refitting on folds 1-9, which gives one-hot widths 13/53/14 (new levels: site: ['049']), meta_dim 0 / 3 / 83 and head first-Linear input widths 256 / 259 / 339 for signal_only / signal_plus_physio / signal_plus_all. Fusion location, raw metadata entry, and everything else in 'metadata_fusion' are unchanged.
untrained_onehot_columns_note: One-hot columns that are all-zero in training (__UNKNOWN__, and __MISSING__ where absent in training: folds 1-8 fit ['device=__MISSING__', 'device=__UNKNOWN__', 'nurse=__UNKNOWN__', 'site=__UNKNOWN__']; folds 1-9 fit ['device=__MISSING__', 'device=__UNKNOWN__', 'nurse=__UNKNOWN__', 'site=__UNKNOWN__']) receive zero gradient, but AdamW's decoupled weight decay only shrinks their first-Linear weights multiplicatively: prod over steps of (1 - wd * lr_step) = 0.7071 over 6850 development steps and 0.6773 over 7700 final steps (computed from the actual OneCycle lr schedule with max_lr 0.01). So ~68% of the random initial weight remains: a record mapped to such a column gets a small random input shift in signal_plus_all. Affects fold-9 signal_plus_all results in v0.7 (2 fold-9 records under the folds 1-8 encoder: {'device': 0, 'site': 2, 'nurse': 0}). Under the folds 1-9 encoder, 0 fold-10 records map to such a column (cross-check: expected 0).
post_fold10_rules: 1. No model that enters the H3 analysis or any comparison listed in this file is trained after fold 10 is opened.
2. Any re-execution of v0.9 uses only the saved, sha256-verified v0.8 state_dicts and the saved, sha256-verified fold-10 probability files.

3. Ablations listed in the project plan that require training (random-split ablation; height/weight sensitivity) are POST-HOC studies: they run under their own version ids, never modify or overwrite any H3 / listed-comparison artifact, and are reported separately from pre-registered results.

4. The device/site permutation ablation (device + site + nurse one-hot block; specification in exploratory_fold10_comparisons) is done at inference time on the saved v0.8 state_dicts (permutation of metadata input), exploratory.

bootstrap.data: fold 10 (2198 records), labels NORM/MI/STTC/CD/HYP derived with the v0.2.1 code
bootstrap.patients: patients = np.unique(fold-10 patient_id as int64) (sorted); patient_row_list[i] = array of fold-10 row positions of patients[i], rows in fold-10 file order (ptbxl_database.csv row order); reference_implementation.patient_rows_in_file_order
bootstrap.index_matrix: BOOT_IDX is built by N_BOOT sequential calls rng.integers(0, n_patients, size=n_patients) on one Generator(BOOT_SEED=7), row b = call b, exactly as v0.3; a single call with size=(N_BOOT, n_patients) is not used (reference_implementation.build_boot_idx). Each draw: rows = np.concatenate([patient_row_list[i] for i in BOOT_IDX[b]]).
bootstrap.sharing: BOOT_IDX is generated ONCE and shared by every comparison, every seed and both architectures (fully paired)
bootstrap.per_draw: macro-AUROC of each arm = mean over NORM, MI, STTC, CD, HYP of fast_auc (v0.2.1 function) on the drawn rows; delta = arm_B - arm_A (H3: arm_B = signal_plus_all, arm_A = signal_plus_physio)
bootstrap.nan_rule: if a class has no positives or no negatives in a draw, that draw's macro delta is NaN; it is excluded (not redrawn) and the count is reported; if > 1% of draws are NaN this is flagged in the report
bootstrap.point_estimate: delta on the full fold 10 (not the bootstrap mean)
bootstrap.ci: percentile, np.percentile(valid_deltas, q, method='linear'); 95% = [2.5, 97.5], 90% = [5, 95]; no rounding before any comparison
bootstrap.primary_input: per-record probabilities averaged (arithmetic mean) over seeds 42, 123, 2024 per arm and per architecture, then macro-AUROC. Per-seed deltas (same BOOT_IDX) are secondary.

locked_hashes.serialization: fold10_ids: (n, 2) array [ecg_id, patient_id] in fold-10 file order, cast to '<i8', C-order bytes; fold10_patients: np.unique(patient_id) as '<i8' bytes; boot_idx: BOOT_IDX (2000 x 1904) as '<i8' C-order bytes; perm_idx: PERM_IDX (20 x 2198) as '<i8' C-order bytes
locked_hashes.v0.9_rule: v0.9 regenerates all four with reference_implementation and asserts equality before any metric

bootstrap.deviation_from_v0.3: v0.3 excluded a NaN class from the macro mean (per-class nan-skip); this protocol excludes the whole draw. In v0.3 (fold 9) no draw was affected (0 invalid replicates).

H3_decision.status: resolution of the overlap between sealed rules a and b; written before fold 10 is opened

definitions.b_holds: 90% CI entirely within the CLOSED interval [-0.01, +0.01] (lo90 >= -0.01 and hi90 <= 0.01)
definitions.sign: '+' if lo95 > 0, '-' if hi95 < 0 (the side of 0 the 95% CI lies on)

verdict_table.a and b: statistically detectable, below the materiality threshold
verdict_table.a and not b, not material: acquisition metadata changes performance (sign: +/-); magnitude relative to SESOI undetermined

rationale.materiality: materiality uses the 95% CI because H3 is two-sided and a materiality claim is a union over two directions (alpha split 0.025 per side)
rationale.equivalence: the equivalence condition (b) uses the 90% CI because TOST is an intersection-union test

H3_decision.reporting_rule: the sealed labels a/b/c are always reported verbatim (sealed_H3_protocol_verbatim.decision) next to the verdict, together with a_holds, b_holds, material, the point estimate and both CIs

reporting_order: 2. Robustness: inception1d, same procedure, same verdict table.
3. Secondary: per-seed deltas for both architectures.
4. Disagreements between architectures or between seed-averaged and per-seed results are reported as they are; none is resolved by selection.
5. Exploratory results after all of the above.

exploratory_fold10_comparisons.rule: closed list; anything else is post-hoc and labelled so
exploratory_fold10_comparisons.physio_minus_signal_only: signal_plus_physio - signal_only: both architectures, seed-averaged probabilities, same BOOT_IDX, point estimate, 95% and 90% percentile CIs; no decision label. Purpose: unbiased estimate of the age/sex effect. (No signal_plus_all - signal_only comparison.)
exploratory_fold10_comparisons.per_class_deltas: per-class deltas (NORM, MI, STTC, CD, HYP) for the H3 pair (signal_plus_all - signal_plus_physio), both architectures, seed-averaged, same BOOT_IDX, point estimate and 95% percentile CI per class (a per-class draw is NaN only if that class is degenerate in the draw); no multiplicity correction, no decision label

acquisition_permutation.what: signal_plus_all, both architectures; joint permutation of the device + site + nurse one-hot block across fold-10 records (rows of the block are permuted together; age_imputed, age_censored and sex stay fixed); permuted metadata row i = acquisition block of record PERM_IDX[r, i]
acquisition_permutation.repetitions: N_PERM = 20 sequential rng.permutation(2198) calls on one default_rng(PERM_SEED = 42) (reference_implementation.build_perm_idx); PERM_IDX hash locked in bootstrap.locked_hashes
acquisition_permutation.seeds: in each repetition the SAME permutation is applied to all three seed models; their probabilities are averaged, then macro-AUROC
acquisition_permutation.report: mean and range (min, max) over the 20 repetitions of drop = macro-AUROC(unpermuted) - macro-AUROC(permuted); no CI, no decision label
acquisition_permutation.timing: inference only, on the saved v0.8 state_dicts (post_fold10_rules 4)

disclosures: Fold-10 metadata (device/site/nurse distributions) was examined in the audit stages (details in disclosures_fold10_exposure); v0.6 kept only ecg_id, patient_id, device, site and nurse of the fold-10 rows in a variable (pd.read_csv parsed every column once; the other fold-10 columns were dropped immediately and never used).
Selected lr 0.01 is the upper edge of the grid for both architectures; lr values differed by at most 0.0023 (resnet) / 0.0045 (inception) on one seed, i.e. within plausible seed noise.

The models are re-implementations from memory of helme/ecg_ptbxl_benchmarking; they will be compared to the repository before writing, and deviations reported as limitations; the architecture is NOT changed.
Per-record aggregation is the mean over windows (reference may use max), fixed a priori in dev_protocol.json.

reference_implementation.usage: v0.9 executes this exact string (asserting sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes) and uses its functions for every fold-10 number: fast_auc (v0.2.1, verbatim), patient grouping, BOOT_IDX, PERM_IDX, paired bootstrap, percentile CIs, H3 verdict

hashes_note: every document has two hashes: self_sha256 (canonical JSON without the key) and file sha256 (bytes on disk, what OpenTimestamps stamps). Both are recorded.
self_sha256_procedure: Load the JSON file; remove the key 'self_sha256' (the key must be absent, not empty); serialize the remaining dict with json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')); compute SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes; the hex digest must equal the stored 'self_sha256'. (At write time numpy scalars were converted to plain JSON types first, so the loaded file hashes identically.)
